notes: Verified ungated Hugging Face GGUFs. Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen 3.5 rows 404 or gated — replaced with Qwen 2.5 Instruct Q4_K_M. Small 0.5B is the downloadable default for 4 GB machines. Stage 6: every downloadable row carries the Hub LFS sha256; the 0.5B and 1.5B hashes were confirmed by hashing the downloaded files, 3B / 7B were the Hub x-linked-etag values until Stage 10 (2026-09-04, darwin-arm64): both files were downloaded and hashed locally — confirmed by download, no change.
